record.viewport: 390 CSS px wide phone, dark mode
record.summary: Apart from the accepted deviations, the render matches the reference.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panels. The Overview tab shows the Inbox, Queue and Context drift panels (R5, R6, R9) and no Chats panel: that is NCC-130's next PR (Chats, with its pager; LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: The render has no Chats panel, search, filter chips or pager. The page below Context drift is empty down to the tab bar.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Context drift. ncc check gives one line of text for each finding, with no repository and no kind, so the panel has a row for each finding (3 here) where the frame groups 22 findings by repository with a count and a chevron. The line over the rows says when the check ran and what it reads ("Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks."), where the frame has a clock time and other checks ("AGENTS.md length, links and folder layout"), which wait for a later check. The heading is PageHeader at its pane size, as Inbox and Queue are.
accepted_deviations.note: The panel has three plain finding rows with no counts or chevrons. The count is 3, and the line at the top reads "Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks."

accepted_deviations.as_given: Queue. "In progress" lists the open PRs with their pills, and no priority mark or owner chat on a row ("the-bridge#535" without "· bridge-workbench"): both come from Linear, which is out of scope. There is no "Up next" group, so the Queue counts its open PRs: 3 where the frame says 8, and "In progress" 3 where the frame says 4 over three rows.
accepted_deviations.note: With no priority mark, the row text starts further left (about x 38 instead of 64). Because the text column is wider, two titles wrap at other words. Both follow from this deviation.

accepted_deviations.as_given: To review. The group shows as the frame draws it, closed with 17. On the live page it is empty until backend-coord decides how a chat's Inbox item names its project.
Panel headings. "Inbox" and "Queue" are PageHeader at its pane size (15 px, the count in mono), where the frame has an 18/24 heading and a 13 px count: no text style is 18 px (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).

Panel border. Each panel heading sits where the frame draws it, 20 under the tabs, but its panel starts 2 px lower than the frame's (the Inbox panel's top border at y 310 where the frame has 308): the frame puts the panel 14 under the 44 px heading row, which no spacing token has, so it is 16 (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Spacing 14).

Row height. The Inbox and Queue rows are 72 px apart where the frame's are 74, so each panel is 2 px shorter for each row and the closed "To review" row ends higher: the library's compact ListRow with phone sides is 72 high (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Compact list row 74 on the phone).
Panel gap. One panel over the other, they are 24 apart where the frame has 28, which no spacing token has (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).

Tabs. The tab row shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture, QA and Ideas, where the frame shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture and QA: only the tabs of shipped increments show (d-133). Repositories and Architecture are increment two's live slices, QA increment three's and Ideas increment one's, so Ideas comes after QA.
accepted_deviations.note: QA and Ideas are past the right edge of the scrolling row in the render, so they cannot be seen. QA is also past the edge in the reference. The three tabs that show match.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Quick chat shows as the frame draws it; no frame draws its composer, so it is the library Dialog on every size, and in a state it opens nothing.

Owner's name. NCC-1701's purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace", where the frame has the owner's name: the secret scan's personal-term rule keeps the name out of web/, so the purpose breaks its lines at other words. The live page shows the brain's own words.
Name size. The name is the 28 px heading, where the frame draws 24, which no text style has (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Phone page title 24), so it is wider and its line ends 4 px lower.

Picture. The picture is 64 px square, as on T01b and D01, where this frame draws 56, which no size token has (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Project picture 56). The name and the purpose keep the frame's 16 px gap, so they start 8 px right of the frame's.

Tab padding. The selected tab is the library's large item tab, 4 px wider than the frame's and 2 px further in from the page's edge, and each later tab starts a little further right, Architecture about 12 px (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Phone item tabs).

Tab row. The five tabs run past the right edge, as the frame's row of five does, and the row scrolls. As in the frame, the row runs to the screen's right edge, past the page's 16 px side, so Architecture shows whole.
Tab bar. The tab bar is the app's shared one in the default order (d-105): Home, Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More. The frame draws Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More.

limits: Both images were shown to me at about 390 px wide, so I could not check differences under about 2 px reliably.
I did not read the optional pixel diff image.
QA and Ideas in the tab row are past the right edge of the render, so I could not check them.
